parameters.text:
=You are an expert career writer. Based on the Job Description and the Candidate's Resume, perform the following two tasks.

### ROLE DETAILS
- Job Title: {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_title }}
- Company: {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.company_name }}

### CANDIDATE RESUME
{{ $('Extract from File').item.json.text }}

### JOB DESCRIPTION
{{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_description }}

### INSTRUCTIONS
First, write a persuasive, ATS-friendly cover letter as an HTML fragment for this job: {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_description }} or {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_title }}.

Second, rewrite the resume as a clean HTML fragment optimized for this job: {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_description }} or {{ $('Loop Over Items').item.json.job_title }}.

Structure your entire response with the following clear headings so I can parse it easily. Do not include any other text or explanation.

### REWRITTEN RESUME ###
[The full rewritten resume HTML goes here]

### COVER LETTER ###
[The full cover letter HTML goes here]

parameters.text:
=You are an expert hiring manager.

Your task: analyze the Job Description and Candidate Resume. Compare the Job description to the candidate resume, identify the skills, determine the matching level between the two and come up with a score.

### INSTRUCTIONS
Return a single JSON object with two keys: "skills" and "score".
- "skills": An array of the top skills from the job description.
- "score": A number from 1 to 5 indicating how well the resume matches the job skills.

Return ONLY the raw JSON object with no markdown formatting, no code blocks, no backticks.

Example Output:
{
  "skills": ["Project Management", "Agile Methodologies", "JIRA"],
  "score": 4
}

### JOB DESCRIPTION
{{ $json.job_description }}

### CANDIDATE RESUME
{{ $('Extract from File').item.json.text }}
